item.title: Middle East Eye: Explosions reported near tanker off southern Yemen: UKMTO
item.description: Explosions reported near tanker off southern Yemen: UKMTO A tanker reported seeing several explosions nearby about 60 nautical miles south of the Yemeni port city of Mocha in the Gulf of Aden on Sunday, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency said. item.title: Middle East Eye: Israeli strikes and detonations hit several towns in southern Lebanon
item.description: Israeli strikes and detonations hit several towns in southern Lebanon Israeli forces carried out a large detonation in the Wadi Hassan area, on the outskirts of Majdal Zoun in southern Lebanon, the National News Agency (NNA) reported. Israeli warplanes also struck the town of Haddatha in the Bint Jbeil district, the agency said. Elsewhere in the south, a munition left over from earlier Israeli attacks exploded on the outskirts of the town of Srifa. No injuries were reported.
